claim: Figure 1 (as held) reports c_pi = 3, P(c_pi) = 3 for P-256; this contradicts the published P-256 parameters.
derivation: t = p + 1 - n; minus_d_pi = 4*p - t^2; if 3 | c_pi then 9 | c_pi^2 | d_pi, contradicting minus_d_pi = 3 (mod 9). The argument is independent of the D1 s-vs-s/2 branch: 3 | c_pi implies 3 | s implies 9 | s^2 | d_pi either way.
check: assert minus_d_pi_mod_9 == 3  # hence 3 does not divide c_pi, contradicting the held c_pi = 3
